PlayerProfile.title: PlayerProfile
PlayerProfile.description: Authenticated AstroPop player progression, booster inventory, Star Coins, daily streak, and preferences.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the player.

totalStars.description: Total stars earned across saga levels.

endlessHighScore.description: Best score in Endless Panic mode.

starCoins.description: In-game Star Coins earned for boosters and extra shots.

dailyStreak.description: Consecutive Daily Cosmic Challenge streak count.

lastDailyDay.description: ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD) of last completed Daily Challenge.

soundEnabled.description: Whether synthesized arcade audio is enabled.

hapticsEnabled.description: Whether tactile haptic feedback is enabled.

lastLoginRewardDate.description: ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD) of last claimed daily supply.

lastWheelSpinDate.description: ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD) of last free Lucky Wheel spin.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was created.

LevelProgress.title: LevelProgress
LevelProgress.description: Best score and star rating for a single Starlight Saga level.

bestScore.description: Best score achieved on this level.

completed.description: Whether the level has been cleared.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when record was created.

GameRun.title: GameRun
GameRun.description: Immutable record of a completed Saga, Endless, or Daily Challenge run.

levelNumber.description: Level number for SAGA, or 0 for ENDLESS/DAILY.

bubblesPopped.description: Total bubbles popped in this run.

/users/{userId}.description: Player progression, Star Coins, daily streak, booster inventory, and preferences.

/users/{userId}/levels/{levelId}.description: Per-level best score and star ratings for Starlight Saga.

/users/{userId}/runs/{runId}.description: Historical completed game runs for stats and personal records.
